projection.method: Latest observed price × exp(fitted annual log-price slope × years ahead)
projection.uncertainty: Conditional 95% model range: log-price innovation variance accumulates with years ahead, plus fitted slope uncertainty. Not a calibrated long-horizon forecast interval.
projection.validation: Rolling one-year-ahead hindcasts for latest five observed years; report mean absolute percentage error and carry-forward comparator. Does not validate ten-year accuracy.
projection.billAssumption: Hold latest observed state monthly kWh/customer constant in all projected years; no household demand, tariff, policy or data-center load forecast.
projection.attribution: Before/after differences describe all-cause state price changes. No data-center share or causal effect is estimated.

calculations.comparison: Price-only comparison holds latest state monthly kWh constant in both years.
